title: Named integral boundary equality for Chern data
statement: For variable coefficient towers R,A and their ring-object map φ, ChernData c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and f : single(integers) → single(units)[1], IntegralBoundaryNormalization l R A φ c f is exactly Fact of the equality underlyingChernArrow l c (c.unitIso.inv ≫ c.reduction.model.derived.map f ≫ c.rootIso.hom) [def-sfb-tower-underlying-arrow] = f ≫ towerKummerBoundary l c.kummer [def-sfb-positive-kummer-boundary]. The standard Fact.out field is precisely this equality; no additional condition or chosen object is supplied.

def IntegralBoundaryNormalization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (R A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (fun n ↦ R.obj (op n))
        (fun n ↦ R.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ⟶
      WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (fun n ↦ A.obj (op n))
        (fun n ↦ A.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    (c : ChernData l T R A φ)
    (f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (integers T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (units T))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) : Prop
